WITH matched AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = t.transreg
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref
), counts AS (
  SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY transreg, tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT transreg, tradekind, transaction_count,
         transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM counts
), type_averages AS (
  SELECT tradekind,
         AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count,
         AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share
  FROM shares
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT transreg, tradekind, transaction_count, share_of_total,
       average_count, average_share
FROM shares
JOIN type_averages USING (tradekind)
ORDER BY transreg, tradekind
